_comment: Your document library. One block per document. The key (e.g. tribune-1957-flood) is an ID you invent -- videos refer to documents by this ID. FORMAT: "your-id": { "file": "exact-filename.pdf", "title": "What it shows", "source": "Paper name", "date": "March 12, 1957" } -- only file and title are required. Separate blocks with commas; no comma after the last one.
